initialize.instructions: Calculator tools: add, subtract, multiply, divide, remainder and exponent on two numbers (a, b); factorial, isPrime and parity (even/odd) on one whole number (n).

tools.description: Divide the first number by the second: a / b. Fails if b is 0
tools.name: divide
tools.title: divide

tools.description: Raise the first number to the power of the second: a ^ b. Fails if the result is not a finite number
tools.name: exponent
tools.title: exponent

tools.description: Factorial of a whole number: n!. Fails unless 0 <= n <= 20
tools.name: factorial
tools.title: factorial

tools.description: Whether a whole number is prime. Returns true or false
tools.name: isPrime
tools.title: isPrime

tools.description: Whether a whole number is even or odd. Returns "even" or "odd"
tools.name: parity
tools.title: parity

tools.description: Remainder of dividing the first number by the second: a % b. Fails if b is 0
tools.name: remainder
tools.title: remainder

tools.description: Subtract the second number from the first: a - b
tools.name: subtract
tools.title: subtract
